name: 拉丝钢台面便携子弹冰制冰机款
description: 开盖可见满篮子弹冰，台面场景与空白尺寸线拆解卖点，参数数值全留白

styleLock.backgroundSystem: backgrounds cycle between seamless studio white #FFFFFF, a pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and an icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, with the dark brushed fascia #2E3237 reserved for the operation macro; one hard-edged solid crimson corner wedge #E21B4F appears only on information and closing screens, never a gradient falloff and never photographic depth blur inside an information screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 5600K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed steel reading as narrow vertical gradient bands instead of mirror smears, short tight contact shadow directly under the base, no warm cast, no coloured rim light and no dramatic hotspot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio sweep #FFFFFF, pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and the moulded basket interior in light brushed grey #DDE2E6; ice is always translucent frost-white with real internal fractures, never a welded block
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif: bold two-line headline in #2D3238 on light fields or #FFFFFF on the wedge, stacked caption slots beside each icon, hairline leader lines ending in one small solid dot; headline 32-38pt, caption 15-18pt, all wording carried as placeholders and no English category word printed in frame
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms only, single uniform stroke weight, drawn in #FFFFFF over the dark band or #2D3238 over light fields, one pictogram per caption slot; no filled pictograms, no gloss, nothing that reads as a certification mark, seal or badge
styleLock.presentationRules: the appliance stays upright at one true scale on the same front axis with the lid hinged open at the same angle across the set, never re-scaled and never clipped; every display, indicator lamp, button face, dimension leader, callout chip and size chip stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; the scoop is the only soft prop and never covers the body
noDrift: no brand wordmark, English category eyebrow, store badge, promotional corner flag or QR block
no digits, units, readouts, daily-ice weight, cycle minutes, capacities or dimensions drawn on any panel, leader line, chip or screen
no colour palette changes and no warm wood, mint, rose-gold or gradient-glass surface replacing the white, marble and icy blue-white fields
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no drop shadow behind headline text
no inconsistent key direction and no mismatched pictogram stroke weights between screens
no dense white fog, no plastic-looking opaque ice cubes and no floating product without a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium countertop-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, ink-grey copy #2D3238 and one crimson accent wedge #E21B4F used only as a solid hard-edged corner block; cool 5600K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed steel reading as narrow vertical gradient bands rather than mirror smears, short tight contact shadow under the base, no warm cast and no coloured rim light; backgrounds cycle between seamless white #FFFFFF, pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and the icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, with the dark brushed fascia #2E3237 only in the operation macro, one hard-edged crimson corner wedge on information and closing screens, never a gradient falloff and never photographic depth blur inside an information screen; one modern geometric sans-serif with a bold two-line headline, stacked caption slots and hairline leader lines ending in one small solid dot, headline 32-38pt and caption 15-18pt, no English category word printed in frame; thin-line pictograms only with one uniform stroke weight, never a seal or badge; the appliance stays upright at one true scale on the same front axis with the lid at one hinge angle, and every display, indicator lamp, button face, dimension leader, callout chip and size chip stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered readouts, no invented figures.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用开盖露出满篮冰粒的干净白底主图一眼赢得点击
shots.camera: straight-on at the unit's own eye level with a slight 3/4 turn to the left, lid open, full body visible with clean headroom
shots.lighting: cool 5600K high-key key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, narrow vertical gradient bands on the brushed shell, short tight contact shadow under the base
shots.props: one ice scoop resting at the lower left, no other prop
shots.whitespace: no copy at all, an even clear margin on all four sides of the unit
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unit stands on a seamless studio white sweep #FFFFFF, seen straight-on at its own eye level with a slight 3/4 turn to the left, the lid hinged open so the loaded basket reads clearly, whole body inside the frame with clean headroom and nothing clipped. Cool 5600K high-key key light from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, the brushed shell rendering as narrow vertical gradient bands, a short tight contact shadow directly under the base. One ice scoop rests at the lower left and no other prop enters the frame. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even clear margin on all four sides and no copy anywhere. Every indicator, button face and panel marking stays a blank unlit surface with no glyph, no digit and no graduation. 4K commercial appliance photography. Negative: no wordmark or logo on the door panel, no rendered text, no digits or units, no lit readout, no gradient or tinted background, no hands, no drink glass, no citrus or fruit, no water streaks on the steel, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges, no duplicated basket.

shots.background: moulded basket interior in light brushed grey #DDE2E6
shots.props: the two moulded handle tabs at the left and right frame edges, no scoop
shots.whitespace: a clean clear band kept across the top third, ice packing the lower two thirds

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底略偏 3/4 机位，开盖露出满篮子弹冰、左下放一把取冰勺；002 抬高的三分之四视角，机身边四条尺寸引出线、右上两枚大小区分的小片、右侧硬边色块标题栏；003 大理石台面正机位，右侧竖排三枚线性图标配短句，右下角斜切色块；004 近乎垂直俯视的特写，满篮子弹冰与后侧滤梳条，顶部一段标题文案；005 深色控制面板特写，一枚指尖按在按键上，指示灯点亮并带字符标签。品类判定依据：机身侧面有压缩机散热孔阵、顶部有制冷控制条与指示灯，属电动制冷设备，故 L1 定为家用电器、L2 定为厨房电器，而非无电机的家居日用厨房用品；源站把它挂在 Home & Kitchen 大类下，此处按图改判。已剥离内容：机门与右下角的品牌字标、斜切色块里的英文品名与日产冰量数值、四条引出线上的英寸数字、三枚图标旁的英文主张原句、004 与 005 顶部的整段英文文案原句、面板上的按键字符与指示标签；日产冰量、单次制冰时长、水箱容积一类事实数值全部不入稿，屏幕、指示灯、尺寸线与规格片一律改写为空白无读数占位；产品主体一律以 {product} 占位，只保留分镜结构、机位、光位、色板与排版骨架。源套图止于面板特写没有收口镜，故末镜按 002/003 已有的硬边斜切色块版式补一镜 CTA，仅沿用其几何结构，不含任何优惠与价格事实。
